Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 56, "heading": "CHAPTER 54. Mr. MICAWBER’S TRANSACTIONS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u056-b0030", "target": "Когда дело было таким образом полюбовно улажено, мистер Микобер подал миссис Микобер руку и, взглянув на груду книг и бумаг, лежавших перед Трэдлсом на столе, сказал, что они оставят нас одних; что они церемонно и исполнили.", "source_sha256": "3676646ec8adf82b1cc33b04ae3a23cdbc5f30459486eadb940c84df5413685c", "target_id": "ru-en85-u056-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b4491152d20ff9ac73f440145c6a863726c0d35eb63a620b19000a83eef59059"}, {"source_id": "en85-u056-b0031", "target": "— Мой дорогой Копперфилд, — сказал Трэдлс, откинувшись на спинку стула, когда они ушли, и глядя на меня с такой любовью, что глаза у него покраснели, а волосы встали во всевозможные формы, — я не извиняюсь за то, что беспокою тебя делами, потому что знаю, как глубоко они тебя занимают, и это может отвлечь твои мысли. Мой дорогой мальчик, надеюсь, ты не вымотан?", "source_sha256": "95035597bc823ef3d7c9235c05deae9588d762f2696354fa5d53cd1af0238ef7", "target_id": "ru-en85-u056-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5be1f40a087df2ebd7e698bcca2581d6d928413035675c0ed8b4ae59e9dba3de"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 54, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u056-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am quite myself,’ said I, after a pause. ‘We have more cause to think of my aunt than of anyone. You know how much she has done.’", "sha256": "c0bad35a98df135d28558bff566f275cf21593682031c926182e493207b3621d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Surely, surely,’ answered Traddles. ‘Who can forget it!’", "sha256": "3f47f78ee539f6383f594d901ad7dc20111f8439fe9f858ef83c36958876eb58", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But even that is not all,’ said I. ‘During the last fortnight, some new trouble has vexed her; and she has been in and out of London every day. Several times she has gone out early, and been absent until evening. Last night, Traddles, with this journey before her, it was almost midnight before she came home. You know what her consideration for others is. She will not tell me what has happened to distress her.’", "sha256": "711bb7d605f143eb6d3c16a72366c2b29870966bcc6c6b5bcd0fbc71c8ecc5ce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt, very pale, and with deep lines in her face, sat immovable until I had finished; when some stray tears found their way to her cheeks, and she put her hand on mine.", "sha256": "8e6a29c60085b540b56cbcc63eefaa98e34b2455c60225ea5d4f72107db800a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s nothing, Trot; it’s nothing. There will be no more of it. You shall know by and by. Now Agnes, my dear, let us attend to these affairs.’", "sha256": "3847476702ff299ed61186869f17bbd6ad587f0dce238b1f4b0b5be616088286", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I must do Mr. Micawber the justice to say,’ Traddles began, ‘that although he would appear not to have worked to any good account for himself, he is a most untiring man when he works for other people. I never saw such a fellow. If he always goes on in the same way, he must be, virtually, about two hundred years old, at present. The heat into which he has been continually putting himself; and the distracted and impetuous manner in which he has been diving, day and night, among papers and books; to say nothing of the immense number of letters he has written me between this house and Mr. Wickfield’s, and often across the table when he has been sitting opposite, and might much more easily have spoken; is quite extraordinary.’", "sha256": "acee1fce76217c0f177ebcefeb087471fb12352dfb2e4f1119f3b70a34a892da", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Letters!’ cried my aunt. ‘I believe he dreams in letters!’", "sha256": "f1a094767c75a0bce77df774af7c31623f02d6e7f3aeccccc1d54cf21dc1b7fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There’s Mr. Dick, too,’ said Traddles, ‘has been doing wonders! As soon as he was released from overlooking Uriah Heep, whom he kept in such charge as I never saw exceeded, he began to devote himself to Mr. Wickfield. And really his anxiety to be of use in the investigations we have been making, and his real usefulness in extracting, and copying, and fetching, and carrying, have been quite stimulating to us.’", "sha256": "1c557eed349eca545dac2609231b1723d923a9f638ef34b124be45efec479423", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dick is a very remarkable man,’ exclaimed my aunt; ‘and I always said he was. Trot, you know it.’", "sha256": "73389a157409676973b173939c5b33dd541f7a2a858a6e88c1f602fa6068a04b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am happy to say, Miss Wickfield,’ pursued Traddles, at once with great delicacy and with great earnestness, ‘that in your absence Mr. Wickfield has considerably improved. Relieved of the incubus that had fastened upon him for so long a time, and of the dreadful apprehensions under which he had lived, he is hardly the same person. At times, even his impaired power of concentrating his memory and attention on particular points of business, has recovered itself very much; and he has been able to assist us in making some things clear, that we should have found very difficult indeed, if not hopeless, without him. But what I have to do is to come to results; which are short enough; not to gossip on all the hopeful circumstances I have observed, or I shall never have done.’ His natural manner and agreeable simplicity made it transparent that he said this to put us in good heart, and to enable Agnes to hear her father mentioned with greater confidence; but it was not the less pleasant for that.", "sha256": "de24ccf144b116799583f2bf55d3387a085287cb797dc19434ca7aef69b8e14b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now, let me see,’ said Traddles, looking among the papers on the table. ‘Having counted our funds, and reduced to order a great mass of unintentional confusion in the first place, and of wilful confusion and falsification in the second, we take it to be clear that Mr. Wickfield might now wind up his business, and his agency-trust, and exhibit no deficiency or defalcation whatever.’", "sha256": "b4a1495ec698f4710e86f46fc780e3e19587bb78de925f66709174e7e94d5157", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, thank Heaven!’ cried Agnes, fervently.", "sha256": "492f1c459a310fe19d102dbe8410ded3e91014fa9a00839f15e9483821ffcce7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But,’ said Traddles, ‘the surplus that would be left as his means of support—and I suppose the house to be sold, even in saying this—would be so small, not exceeding in all probability some hundreds of pounds, that perhaps, Miss Wickfield, it would be best to consider whether he might not retain his agency of the estate to which he has so long been receiver. His friends might advise him, you know; now he is free. You yourself, Miss Wickfield—Copperfield—I—’", "sha256": "5a3febeeb98e47a889711580c329c9bdba0283f7c041c8b30df19d539f7075b8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have considered it, Trotwood,’ said Agnes, looking to me, ‘and I feel that it ought not to be, and must not be; even on the recommendation of a friend to whom I am so grateful, and owe so much.’", "sha256": "cb4e39a334e84b09e17d65f50f9f7b5e56abc013181d205270cfc4e01cd32e96", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I will not say that I recommend it,’ observed Traddles. ‘I think it right to suggest it. No more.’", "sha256": "160775b75f749057af887588341e9bb6dbc14ee784971c22cc546c2d47d4fb07", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am happy to hear you say so,’ answered Agnes, steadily, ‘for it gives me hope, almost assurance, that we think alike. Dear Mr. Traddles and dear Trotwood, papa once free with honour, what could I wish for! I have always aspired, if I could have released him from the toils in which he was held, to render back some little portion of the love and care I owe him, and to devote my life to him. It has been, for years, the utmost height of my hopes. To take our future on myself, will be the next great happiness—the next to his release from all trust and responsibility—that I can know.’", "sha256": "476f31a56599e730cff68ec3fd2435fec458c01e4eafc17a5bec0b562156d8ab", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Have you thought how, Agnes?’", "sha256": "aa552a49e089f3a53d02db84e2139c72e9243f43e8d25ce924f325056ae06962", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Often! I am not afraid, dear Trotwood. I am certain of success. So many people know me here, and think kindly of me, that I am certain. Don’t mistrust me. Our wants are not many. If I rent the dear old house, and keep a school, I shall be useful and happy.’", "sha256": "5f4848e16c31e9dc62d4d287f12b983593f0e1f27ed790a7f95a8bdee729a3b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The calm fervour of her cheerful voice brought back so vividly, first the dear old house itself, and then my solitary home, that my heart was too full for speech. Traddles pretended for a little while to be busily looking among the papers.", "sha256": "3a1964c7446bb1e5f3a522c83b71f2ac120828ddbffa073ac4bca65ab88322b0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Next, Miss Trotwood,’ said Traddles, ‘that property of yours.’", "sha256": "a239e4dfcfdefbce92026b1b015f94c131d8b19e0c6a24c032d3f6c93c31a6d5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, sir,’ sighed my aunt. ‘All I have got to say about it is, that if it’s gone, I can bear it; and if it’s not gone, I shall be glad to get it back.’", "sha256": "4760019287f2b08e702aedfa5c22f578549f3786796a04c5383039fe79f229a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It was originally, I think, eight thousand pounds, Consols?’ said Traddles.", "sha256": "842b0f2d329afb75f52d5b773ea05f47a06ecb570fb55920a800383a1d426433", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Right!’ replied my aunt.", "sha256": "2aff815d7f27903507c1b0f57a8ba1d9d1428b1c2ed37a95bb262dbf5fc38e27", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I can’t account for more than five,’ said Traddles, with an air of perplexity.", "sha256": "1f2aa051ff57f019e80a8a3d7b86b44753d297a59a4d8f1fe1dc66a20cf09e6b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘—thousand, do you mean?’ inquired my aunt, with uncommon composure, ‘or pounds?’", "sha256": "d6b4bdb45fef59379553a3d1c654bc9b5e623fd076455673c1a05d58f2c9887b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Five thousand pounds,’ said Traddles.", "sha256": "5f892744aa1e5ec60c2cee16b2dfff5f2dc16147a4698c34acd818b8fcb9ea48", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It was all there was,’ returned my aunt. ‘I sold three, myself. One, I paid for your articles, Trot, my dear; and the other two I have by me. When I lost the rest, I thought it wise to say nothing about that sum, but to keep it secretly for a rainy day. I wanted to see how you would come out of the trial, Trot; and you came out nobly—persevering, self-reliant, self-denying! So did Dick. Don’t speak to me, for I find my nerves a little shaken!’", "sha256": "43104ada71f80916d9bad2cfcf1f503bfa51804568526eb60a8d762c7cd9446a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Nobody would have thought so, to see her sitting upright, with her arms folded; but she had wonderful self-command.", "sha256": "775eb1fb0d151c4d0bf3ac8c47f7c60a29254efd2c09a99d38ef133728b7f634", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then I am delighted to say,’ cried Traddles, beaming with joy, ‘that we have recovered the whole money!’", "sha256": "0d076fd0876caa1209754750010cc18242bb13805bc231557febd11c6ddb55af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Don’t congratulate me, anybody!’ exclaimed my aunt. ‘How so, sir?’", "sha256": "de5ba058c66dd9b0a31c2e6595f8ddd015bc768a05b7afdbe34164be1659ef17", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You believed it had been misappropriated by Mr. Wickfield?’ said Traddles.", "sha256": "bba9c38ee5d6084e47f6bfe1177a71ed63b6ed0adbeaf3d7689ae3da27b580e9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u056-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Of course I did,’ said my aunt, ‘and was therefore easily silenced. Agnes, not a word!’", "sha256": "5dfb8ac9aa50aff15c97009d5175e04786cb77ef64e8ba27fca2aee506f27688", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[61]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
